Name: Simple Hoarder Chest
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b]✦ Simple Hoarder Chest ✦[/b][/size]

[size=5][color=#FFE680][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[size=4][size=5][b]📦 Storage & upgrades[/b][/size]

Main Chest shows all items; category compartments sort materials, farming, fishing, foraging, minerals, food, equipment and miscellaneous items. Search items, add up to 24 custom tabs, hide/restore tabs and delete empty custom tabs.

Starts with 120 regular slots. Each H kit adds 120, up to 1,200 by default or an optional 9,960 ceiling. Category/custom compartments use a per-matching-item limit of 9,999, with 999/Unlimited alternatives.

[size=5][b]🛠 Getting started[/b][/size]

Read Robin’s introduction letter, then buy the 25,000g recipe from her normal shop; it teaches both Hoarder Chest and H kit. Each recipe needs 1 empty regular Chest, 200 Wood, 15 Hardwood, 10 Iron Bars and 5 Gold Bars. Occupied, special, favourite and protected chests cannot be ingredients.

Select an H kit, right-click a placed Hoarder Chest and confirm. H kits upgrade only Hoarder Chests, not ordinary chests.

[size=5][b]🔄 Transfers & integrations[/b][/size]

Left-click withdraws up to 999 available items; right-click withdraws one. No half-stack withdrawal shortcut is currently available. Deposit Matching moves matching backpack items; Organize combines compatible partial stacks within a compartment. Quality, colour, custom data and protected items remain separate.

Craft from backpack/stored ingredients while respecting favourite/protected items. Optional Better Crafting uses ingredients across compartments. Chests Anywhere retains configured range/ignored-chest rules; Cog → Choose a chest switches eligible chests. Global remote access is an optional override across locations.

Lookup Anything can count stored items/gifts. Optional Convenient Inventory, MH Tool Pouch Extended and Market Town integrations are included. Item Lock/Simple Pouch protections can be toggled on backpack items; stored entries show indicators. Use the cog or optional GMCM for settings.

[size=5][b]📥 Requirements & removal[/b][/size]

PC Stardew Valley 1.6.15, SMAPI 4.1+, 12 languages. Extract SimpleHoardChest into Mods, replacing the prior copy. All multiplayer players should use the same version. [b]Empty every compartment through Main before removing the mod.[/b]

For stack issues, keep the affected stacks separate in your backpack, select one and run shc_stack_info in SMAPI. Open/stand beside the chest to include stored items. This command only reads information; include the item, quality and log in your report.

[size=5][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/size]

Share bugs or suggestions on this mod’s page. For bugs, include your mod/game/SMAPI versions, platform, expected versus actual behaviour, reproduction steps and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url]. Add a screenshot if useful. For suggestions, explain the change and how it would help.[/size]
